notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest and three additional lands.
Archelos is untapped.
description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary, a Forest and three other lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}{U}.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, a Forest and three other lands, causing you to gain ten life.
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Each land enters the battlefield, triggering Aesi that many times, and Mystic Sanctuary.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Splendid Reclamation on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Aesi triggers, causing you to draw that many cards.
Repeat.
